General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the RH & LH Front Bumper Caps that attach to the Right and Left sides of the Front Bumper
Made from Pre-colored Heavy Black Plastic
Direct Replacement
NOTE: These are new caps with minor imperfections from the molding process. The material is rigid and fitment may be off.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Bumper Cap / Right Side
Qty 1 – Front Bumper Cap / Left Side
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
